jobs.description:
As a Accountant, you will monitor, analyse, and report key expense categories while ensuring accurate financial reporting and effective cost control. Acting as a business partner to various departments, you will provide valuable insights that support operational efficiency and strategic decision-making.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

This position is within the property industry and based near Ternat.

Omschrijving

Reporting to the Accounting Manager, your responsibilities will include:

• Monitoring and analysing operational expenses and project-related costs.
• Managing and overseeing the invoice and purchase order cycle.
• Reviewing accounting entries, allocations, and VAT-related controls.
• Supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, including accruals, reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
• Performing variance analysis and preparing financial reporting for key stakeholders.
• Supporting budgeting, forecasting, and audit processes.
• Ensuring compliance with accounting standards and internal control procedures.
• Contributing to process improvements, financial systems enhancements, and European-wide projects.
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive transparency, efficiency, and cost optimisation.
• Supporting knowledge-sharing and collaboration within the finance team.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 4-5 years of experience in accounting or financial reporting.
• Previous experience within a services, retail, or similar operational environment.
• Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial controls.
• Experience with SAP; S4Hana knowledge is considered a strong asset.
• Advanced Excel skills.
• Good knowledge of IFRS and/or local GAAP standards is an advantage.
• Fluent English communication skills; additional European languages are a plus.
• Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset.
• Comfortable working in an international and fast-paced environment

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but if you’re motivated and hands-on, we’ll get you up to speed.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.

jobs.occupation: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

jobs.occupation: Warehouse worker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team in the night shift. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse operator, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electrical pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in warehouse work or logistics
• Can operate an electrical pallet truck (EPT) with ease
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Specifically want to work in night shift
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
Reach truck experience is a big plus but not required.

jobs.occupation: Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering Data Centres
jobs.description:
As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you will join an international engineering and consultancy firm specialising in the design and delivery of complex technical projects.

Within this position, the focus is on Mission Critical Facilities and data centres. These are technically demanding buildings where systems such as electrical power supply, cooling, redundancy, safety and operational continuity need to be closely integrated.

You will become part of a Belgian engineering team that is being further developed around data centre projects. From Belgium, you will work closely with international engineering teams on projects for both national and international clients.

You will work in a multidisciplinary environment where different technical areas of expertise come together to design and deliver complex projects.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, you coordinate the entire engineering and design process. You monitor the technical scope, planning and engineering budget, ensuring that the different disciplines work together towards one integrated design.

• Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams within complex data centre projects

• Manage the technical scope, engineering budget and associated contract documentation

• Prepare and monitor the engineering schedule and allocate tasks within the team

• Coordinate the different technical disciplines and ensure alignment between their designs

• Coordinate collaboration between Belgian and international engineering teams

• Work closely with external consultants, contractors and other technical partners

• Review technical design decisions and challenge or adjust them where necessary

• Manage design changes and assess their impact on the overall project

• Translate complex client requirements into technically feasible solutions

• Present and discuss technical concepts with clients and project teams

• Remain involved during the execution phase and act as a technical point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders

For the position of Project Lead Multidisciplinary Engineering – Data Centres, we are looking for someone who combines strong technical knowledge with excellent coordination skills. Experience within data centres is an advantage, but experience with industrial buildings or other technically complex building projects can also be a strong match.

• You hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a comparable technical discipline

• You have at least 5 years of experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects

• You have experience leading and coordinating engineers and other technical stakeholders

• You are familiar with complex technical building installations and multidisciplinary engineering

• Experience with data centres, industrial buildings or other complex built environments is a strong advantage

• You are familiar with digital engineering processes, 3D design and BIM environments

• You have a good understanding of relevant standards, regulations and working methods within engineering and construction

• You communicate effectively with engineers, consultants, contractors and clients

• English knowledge is a must, Dutch and French are a plus

Relevant experience is essential for this position. We are specifically looking for candidates who have previously worked in a similar role, coordinating multidisciplinary engineering or design projects within data centres, industrial buildings or other technically complex environments.

If you do not have relevant experience in a comparable position or project environment, we kindly ask you not to apply for this vacancy.

Are you an Inside Sales Representative with experience in the food industry and strong language skills in English plus German, Danish, Swedish or Portuguese? Apply today and join an international trading environment.

Your role as an Inside Sales Representative
For an international company active in the food sector, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to support and expand commercial relationships within the meat industry. As a Sales Support Specialist and Internal Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing customer relationships and ensuring smooth follow-up of the entire sales process.

Your responsibilities:
 
• Manage and develop an existing customer portfolio. 
• Prepare, send and follow up on quotations. 
• Maintain regular contact with restaurants, hotels and retail customers. 
• Identify commercial opportunities and support business growth. 
• Coordinate customer requests and monitor deliveries. 
• Participate in trade fairs and industry events when required. 
• Collaborate closely with internal teams and international partners.
Your profile as an Inside Sales Representative / Internal Account Manager
 
• You have experience in an inside sales, sales support, customer service or commercial administration role. 
• Experience in the food industry. 
• Experience within the meat sector is considered a significant advantage. 
• You communicate fluently in English and at least one of the following languages: German, Danish, Swedish or Portuguese. 
• You have experience with customer follow-up, quotation management and commercial administration. 
• You are comfortable working with common office software and digital systems. 
• You are willing to attend trade fairs on an occasional basis.

Are you an experienced Head Technician with strong troubleshooting skills and knowledge of mechanical, hydraulic and electrical systems? Do you work confidently in English? Apply today.

As a Head Technician, Senior Mechanic or Technical Coordinator, you combine hands-on technical expertise with the daily coordination of a small team. Your main focus is diagnosing and resolving technical issues on heavy equipment.
 
• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hydraulic and electrical faults. 
• Perform assembly, disassembly and modification work on machines. 
• Carry out machine inspections and functional checks. 
• Support machine testing, commissioning and validation activities. 
• Prepare technical reports and troubleshooting guidelines. 
• Coordinate daily work planning and priorities for two mechanics. 
• Perform quality inspections and support continuous improvement initiatives.
For this position, you bring:
 
• Experience in construction equipment, heavy equipment, agricultural machinery, automotive or industrial maintenance. 
• Strong mechanical knowledge. 
• Knowledge of hydraulic and electrical systems. 
• Proven experience in troubleshooting and technical fault finding. 
• Experience coordinating or guiding technicians in daily work planning. 
• Good command of English, as this is the working language. 
• Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook. 
• Sufficient computer skills to work with digital reporting tools and systems.

Looking for an international environment? Do you possess strong B2B communication skills? Then this technical support role within the medical device sector is looking for you! Here in Machelen, you will be handling incoming communication from internal and external stakeholders and be responsible for:

• Following strict internal guidelines to ensure a high level of reporting quality for medical matters.
• Processing and updating projects in SAP.
• Monitoring POs and shipments.
• Escalating more complex problems to the specific departments, which could be regarding accounting or more technical issues. It depends on the problem!
• Logging and archiving of reports and contracts.
• Backup for other administrative tasks.
 

• You communicate fluently in English AND Italian or Spanish.
• In possession of a university degree and a Belgian working permit
• Experience within larger company structures is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse job: order picker in day shift
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

As a Group Food Safety & Quality Assurance (FSQA) Audit & Certification Assistant, you will provide administrative, analytical, and reporting support for food safety audits and certification programs across our international production sites.

The company emphasizes a personal approach, coaching, and growth opportunities, with decisions made locally to adapt to market needs.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Account Manager Medical Devices - East Flanders & Antwerp, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Drive sales of dental implants, prosthetic, and digital solutions in East Flanders & Antwerp, focusing on hospitals, dental practices, and dental labs.
• Understand customer needs and provide complete solutions, from patient acceptance and diagnostic data capture to surgery and final prosthetic delivery.
• Educate dental professionals on the benefits, the utilization and the clinical aspects of products and digital workflows.
• Collaborate with internal teams to ensure high-quality services and products delivery 
• Organize workshops, lunch-and-learn sessions, and participate in trade show

As a successful Account Manager Medical Devices - East Flanders & Antwerp, you will have the following profile:

• +3 years of experience as Account Manager in the Pharma or Medtech industry
• Previous experience in both direct and indirect sales, with strong ability in farming and hunting
• Previous experiences or strong interest in dental products
• Strong presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills
• You are structured and proactive, you achieved KPI & are accurate with CRM update
• Your are autonomous, disciplined, and results-oriented, with a collaborative team spirit.
• Dutch Native & Fluent in English .

jobs.occupation: Group Internal Auditor - Brussels - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Our client is an established international financial services group headquartered in Brussels. Operating in a regulated and international environment, the organisation combines financial expertise with a strong focus on governance, risk management and internal control.

To strengthen its Group Internal Audit department, we are currently looking for an experienced Group Internal Auditor.

Jobomschrijving

• Perform financial, operational and compliance audits across the Group
• Support the Group Chief Internal Auditor in defining and implementing the risk-based internal audit plan
• Independently manage complex audit assignments from scoping to final reporting
• Assess internal controls, governance and risk management frameworks, including IT/ICT-related risks
• Formulate clear and practical recommendations based on audit findings
• Present audit results to senior management and governance bodies
• Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and action plans
• Coordinate audit follow-ups and contribute to the continuous improvement of the Internal Audit function

• Master's degree in Economics, Finance or another relevant field
• At least 7 years of relevant audit experience, ideally acquired within an international environment and/or a Big Four firm
• Strong knowledge of internal audit methodologies, risk-based auditing and internal control frameworks
• Previous exposure to IT/ICT audits is required
• Experience within Banking, Insurance or Financial Services is considered a strong asset
• A CIA, CISA or equivalent professional certification is considered an advantage
• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to translate findings into practical and business-oriented recommendations
• Capable of managing complex audit assignments autonomously from start to finish
• Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to combine critical thinking with diplomacy and influence
• Proactive, structured and comfortable working independently within a compact audit team
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, combined with a good command of Dutch and/or French

• Strong prospecting, networking and relationship-building skills.
• An entrepreneurial mindset with a high degree of autonomy.
• Excellent communication and negotiation abilities.
• The resilience and determination required to develop business within a competitive market.

Experience within packaging, manufacturing, industrial products, paper, printing, labels, plastics or other technical environments is considered a strong advantage.

German is the key success factor for this role.

Given the strategic focus on the DACH region, candidates must possess:
